criteria.criterion: Run `cargo test -p athena-core land::`. A realistic-range test (reading, dispatch, introspection commits, an owner-path commit under a directory with nested .gitattributes '* athena-exclude' named in the doc comment, an intervention adding records/interventions/<month>/<id>.json, then a job's candidate, verification and outcome; no Athena-Job trailers) yields records_only x4, declared_intervention, job_landing with that job and verification id.
criteria.evidence: land::tests::a_realistic_range_is_classified_by_content_with_no_trailers passed. It asserts the kinds [RecordsOnly x4, DeclaredIntervention, JobLanding] and checks that the last commit has job Some(JOB) and verification Some(RecordId(JOB)). range_repo's doc comment names owner-notes/.gitattributes with '* athena-exclude'. No commit message in the test has a trailer.

criteria.criterion: Run `cargo test -p athena-core land::`. Blocked-then-landed: a commit adding candidate, verification and blocked outcome is records_only; a later commit adding only outcome-landed.json plus governed work is job_landing for that job, reusing the gate's closing_jobs logic.
criteria.evidence: a_blocked_job_is_records_only_and_its_later_landed_outcome_is_the_landing passed with the kinds [RecordsOnly, JobLanding], the job and the verification id. classify() calls athena_gate::invariant::closing_jobs, which this change made public.

criteria.criterion: Run `cargo test -p athena-core land::`. Refusal tests each make pr_commits return an error containing the commit's sha: governed change that is neither intervention nor closing records; landing with no verification; landing whose outcome is not landed; owner-path commit without the exclusion.
criteria.evidence: Four refusal tests passed: governed_content_that_is_neither_..., a_landing_without_a_verification_is_refused, a_landing_whose_outcome_is_not_landed_is_refused and an_owner_path_commit_without_the_exclusion_is_refused. They also cover the same-commit .gitattributes case. A further test, a_commit_that_closes_several_jobs_is_refused, also passed. Each goes through refusal(), which asserts that the error contains the sha.

criteria.criterion: Run `cargo test -p athena-core` and `cargo test -p athena-cli --test reconcile`. All pass, including the 5 core reconcile tests and the 2 CLI reconcile tests that failed before; the change description says whether fixtures or code changed and why.
criteria.evidence: Athena's record shows `cargo test --locked` passed with 1094 tests, which includes athena-core and its reconcile tests. I ran `cargo test -p athena-cli --test reconcile`: 2 passed. The CHANGELOG says the fixtures now commit real closing records or a records-only owner-path commit, and that the code was not loosened.

criteria.criterion: Run `cargo test -p athena-core gh::`. Landing commits carry kind/job/verification from pr_commits and pass LandingCommit::validate.
criteria.evidence: 56 passed. records_flow::a_records_only_commit_is_recorded_with_its_kind_and_claims_no_job asserts the kinds [JobLanding, RecordsOnly], that the records-only commit has no job or verification, that commit.validate() and landing.validate() succeed, and that intent.job_ids lists only the landed job. GitLandingRecords::commits now copies c.kind, c.job and c.verification.

findings.summary: No change description listing every caller and writer with its covering test and the commands run (criterion 7).
findings.evidence: The commit message is 'candidate'. The CHANGELOG entry leaves out run.rs retry_landing and drain.rs (crates/athena-cli/src/drain.rs PrLander), gives no test for each caller, and cites no commands. A grep shows pr_commits is called only from gh.rs GitLandingRecords::commits; reconcile.rs and the CLI tests reach it through GitLandingRecords. run.rs and drain.rs do not call it, so leaving them unchanged is correct, but the description must say so.

findings.summary: The CLI reconcile test copies the record fixtures instead of sharing them.
findings.evidence: crates/athena-cli/tests/reconcile.rs landed_job_records repeats the Candidate, Verification and Outcome literals from land::fixtures, which is cfg(test) and pub(crate), so the integration test cannot use it. The two copies can drift apart when the record schemas change.

findings.summary: The 'outcome not landed' refusal test uses a missing outcome, not a non-landed one.
findings.evidence: a_landing_whose_outcome_is_not_landed_is_refused commits a candidate and a verification with no outcome. A blocked outcome is left out by closing_jobs, so it reaches the 'nothing verified it' refusal instead, which the governed-content test covers.

summary: The code change works. `pr_commits` now sorts each commit by what it changes, with no trailers. It reuses the gate's `closing_jobs`, which is now public and documented as the single source of truth. `GitLandingRecords` copies kind, job and verification from it. Fixtures in gh.rs, reconcile.rs and the CLI reconcile test now commit real closing records instead of trailers, and the code was not loosened. All targeted tests passed when I ran them: `cargo test -p athena-core land::` (14), `gh::` (56) and `--test reconcile` (2). Athena's recorded `cargo test --locked`, clippy and fmt checks passed, and I ran `cargo fmt --check` myself; it was clean. The docs and CHANGELOG describe the new rules, and every changed file is on the deliverables list. The verdict is fail for one reason: criterion 7 is unmet. The candidate carries no change description (the commit message is only "candidate"). The one description in the tree, the CHANGELOG entry, does not mention run.rs retry_landing or drain.rs, does not name the test covering each caller, and cites no commands. If a producer report exists outside this snapshot, it was not given to me.
